item.title: Koi Doki
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Etoiles
  • 発売日: 2014-06-27
  • スコア: 6.779999999999999/10 (21 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 恋DOKi
  • 英語名: Koi Doki

别名

  • 恋DOKI －コ・イ・ド・キ－

あらすじ

Yuzuru is like any male student: he wants to be popular and do it with a girl. He talks about sex with his classmates and has perverted fantasies when he looks at cute girls. He chooses his wardrobe carefully and reads books about sex and watches AVs to prepare for the moment when it appears. Even though he’s been marked as a troublemaker by the public moral committee’s Suzuka, it’s still an enjoyable school life to him. He doesn’t feel lonely at home while his parents are away overseas since his younger sister Kokoro is always there to greet him with a smile.

item.title: Mizukano! ~Mizugi no Kanojo to H Shiyo~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Etoiles
  • 発売日: 2013-07-26
  • スコア: 6.81/10 (25 人評価)
  • 日本語名: みずカノ！ ～水着の彼女とHしよっ～
  • 英語名: Mizukano! Mizugi no Kanojo to H Shiyo

あらすじ

In the future, the ice in the South Pole had melted, causing the global sea levels to rise. The popularity of swimsuits had exploded as people got accustomed to a life next to the sea. One of the top-selling swimsuit makers bought one of the new islands Takaojima and built a research school there. At this dormitory school, those who help out with creating new swimsuits do not have to pay a portion of their tuition.

  • 英語名: Himitsu no Otome Boku ga Onna no Ko ni Natta Wake

别名

  • ヒミツのオトメ ～ボクが女の子になった理由（わけ）～

あらすじ

One day Kazuki Kurachi, successor of a dojo and the protagonist of this story, is made to wear female clothes by his sister. While doing so he witnesses a bank robbery and saves a girl who was taken hostage. Impressed by his abilities and not seeing through his disguise, the girl makes Kurachi her bodyguard, and the protagonist starts to attend all-girls school as a female student Natsuki.

item.title: Colorful☆Cure
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Etoiles
  • 発売日: 2012-06-29
  • スコア: 5.86/10 (16 人評価)
  • 日本語名: カラフル☆きゅあ～
  • 英語名: Colorful☆Cure

あらすじ

Demons pose a threat to mankind and it is up to mahou shoujo to defeat them. However, they gain impurities as they use magic, destined to become demons themselves one day. Kureha is a student at Mizukikou Gakuen who awakened as a saint who can cleanse the impurities of mahou shoujo by touching them. After that, demons and other beings attacked him constantly with four mahou shoujos protecting him. They were the school idol Aoi who he had saved earlier, his osananajimi Hanatsu who made a contract to become a mahou shoujo in order to protect him, the robot Ars who travelled from the past to meet him, and the blonde vampire Vermillion who came to be purified by him.

item.title: Sis Koi
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Etoiles
  • 発売日: 2011-07-29
  • スコア: 6.65/10 (19 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 妹恋～しすこい～
  • 英語名: Sis Koi

あらすじ

Yuuichi has twin little sisters, energetic Miyu and tsundere Yui. They keep appealing to him at home and at school, but he doesn’t see them as more than his little sisters. One day, he peeked at Honoka changing in the literary club room and somehow it ended with Miyu and Yui joining the club as well. Then his father called him suddenly and revealed that one of the twins was not blood-related to him! Suddenly, he saw them as girls instead of imoutos. How will he be able to withstand their advances?

item.title: Hime x Hime
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Etoiles
  • 発売日: 2009-09-18
  • スコア: 6.75/10 (17 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 姫×姫
  • 英語名: Hime x Hime

别名

  • ヒメヒメ

あらすじ

There is a famous school where rich boys and girls belong to. The school has a traditional custom that a girl called princess governs the school. The main character accidentally enters the school though he is just an average student. But he can’t move to a school dormitory because of some troubles, so he starts living at Saki’s, the current princess, room. Saki is selfish and he works as her tool. He doesn’t like his school life at first, but he gradually gets attracted to Saki…
